tools.name: fetch_knowledge
tools.description: Return the Markdown source of one documentation page, addressed by an id from search_knowledge or list_knowledge. The first line is the page's URL, for citation. Long pages come back as a heading outline instead; pass section to read one part of them.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.description: List the documentation table of contents: the id, title, source, section and summary of every page. Use this to see what exists when a search does not find the right words; prefer search_knowledge when you know what you are looking for.
